text: Hera Pheri ("Foul Play" in English) is a 2000 comedy Bollywood movie directed by Priyadarshan and is widely regarded as a cult classic and one of the best Hindi comedy films ever made. The film is a remake of the 1989 Malayalam film Ramji Rao Speaking and follows the characters Raju (played by Akshay Kumar), Shyam (played by Suniel Shetty) and Babu Bhaiya (played by Paresh Rawal) as they get involved in various comedic hi-jinks. The movie received a sequel titled Phir Hera Pheri (translates to "Foul Play Again") in 2006, with the original cast reprising their roles. Over the years, particularly in the early 2020s, Hera Pheri has inspired many memes , most of which are used as exploitable image macros online.
